messages:
Morgan H: Quick status — we ran q8-v2 (quant8) at 3% vs baseline for 24h. Summary: token cost -24%, p50 latency +6ms, p95 +22ms, overall error rate stable but 'multi-turn-summarize' subset shows accuracy drop ~4.5% absolute. Want concrete gating/rollback thresholds before we bump to 10%.
Jana P: Can you paste the sample sizes and CI for that subset? 4.5% sounds noisy if n small.
Morgan H: total requests in canary = 18.2k, subset n=820. 95% CI for subset delta = +/-1.1% so signal seems real. Also saw a 1.6x increase in regen ratio on follow-ups.
Li Chen: Noted. Proposal: auto-fallback if either of these triggers happens for 30m window:
- accuracy_delta_abs >= 1.0% (worse)
- regen_ratio increase >= 1.25x
- p95 latency increase >= 20ms AND error_rate increase >= 0.1%
Use conservative windowing to avoid flapping.
Arjun S: +1 to combining optics. Suggest sigmoid ramping for traffic shifts rather than jumps. e.g., traffic(t) = max_pct * sigmoid((t - t0)/tau). smoother and safer when metrics are near thresholds.
Li Chen: Example gating config snippet I tested locally:
```
canary:
  initial_pct: 0.03
  max_pct: 0.30
  ramp: sigmoid
  tau_minutes: 45
rollback_criteria:
  - metric: accuracy_delta_abs
    direction: worse
    threshold: 0.01
    window_minutes: 30
  - metric: regen_ratio
    direction: increase
    threshold: 1.25
    window_minutes: 30
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    direction: increase
    threshold: 20
    and:
      metric: error_rate
      direction: increase
      threshold: 0.001
    window_minutes: 15
```
Morgan H: That looks good. For rollout policy I'd like an absolute hard-stop: if any single metric crosses 2x the threshold we immediately cut traffic to 0 and notify oncall.
Jana P: Agree on hard-stop. Also add a dry-run that sends alerts but doesn't rollback for first 2 hours to gather signals.
infra-bot: deploy-canary q8-v2 -> 3% at 2026-03-20T13:04:16Z (mock)
deploy-bot: canary-observability: dashboards updated, alerts created: ML-Canary-Accuracy, ML-Canary-Regens, ML-Canary-Latency
Arjun S: Action items: 1) add Li's config to canary-policy repo and enable dry-run for next 2h, 2) add sigmoid ramp math comments in docs, 3) alert runbook: immediate rollback + postmortem owner if hard-stop triggered.
Morgan H: I'll push the PR for config and hold on increasing to 10% until we see dry-run alerts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jana P: Ping me once PR is up, I'll sanity-check thresholds against long-tail evals.
Li Chen: I'll also add a targeted eval set for multi-turn summarization to the periodic canary tests.
Morgan H: noted, tnx.
